channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Rafael Grossi: the next Iran nuclear deal will look very different
item.description: IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi says the 2015 Iran nuclear deal is no longer a workable model.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump talks to Hezbollah, Israel as Lebanon fighting surges
item.description: Israeli National Security Minister Ben-Gvir says 'time' to say 'no' to Trump and continue striking Hezbollah in Lebanon.

item.title: Clashes continue in Lebanon despite Israel and Hezbollah accepting US partial ceasefire plan
item.description: A cessation of hostilities between Israel and Hezbollah is seen as crucial to the peace process with Iran.

item.title: Bowen: Trump needs this war to end but Iran is not backing down
item.description: Under pressure from the polls and Gulf allies, the White House is pushing for a deal but Iran wants concessions, writes BBC's international editor.

item.title: Missing lab worker found dead in New Mexico nearly a year after disappearing
item.description: Melissa Casias' case was part of debunked speculations about recent deaths and disappearances in the US scientific community.

item.title: Six people killed in Iowa domestic dispute, police say
item.description: The suspected shooter was found dead near a bridge with a self-inflicted gunshot wound, authorities say.

item.title: Iran attacks damage 20 US military sites since start of war, satellite images show
item.description: Analysts told BBC Verify that Tehran's strikes were more extensive than publicly acknowledged.
